title: MySQL AB is founded
note: David Axmark, Allan Larsson and Michael “Monty” Widenius found MySQL AB in Sweden. The first MySQL release goes out in May 1995.

title: MySQL AB acquires NDB
note: MySQL AB buys the NDB clustered database technology from Ericsson. It becomes MySQL Cluster.

title: Oracle buys Innobase
note: Oracle acquires Innobase Oy, the Finnish company behind InnoDB, MySQL’s main transactional storage engine.

title: Percona is founded
note: Peter Zaitsev and Vadim Tkachenko, who had led MySQL AB’s High Performance Group, leave MySQL AB and found Percona as a MySQL performance consultancy. Its patched builds become Percona Server.

title: Sun buys MySQL AB
note: Sun Microsystems completes its purchase of MySQL AB for about one billion US dollars. Monty Widenius leaves Sun in early 2009 and starts MariaDB.

title: Oracle completes its purchase of Sun
note: Oracle takes over Sun Microsystems, and with it MySQL. MySQL 5.5, released that December, is the first GA under Oracle.

title: The OurSQL Foundation launches
note: A vendor-neutral 501(c)(6) non-profit for the MySQL ecosystem: events, shared resources and a collective voice on the MySQL roadmap, working alongside Oracle. Its founding board comes from Percona, PlanetScale, PingCAP, VillageSQL, Alibaba and the wider community, with Vadim Tkachenko as president.
